International Admissions
The University of West Florida hosts more than 300 international students from more than 85 countries. At UWF, we believe in the power of higher education to drive change on campus and around the world. We welcome applicants from all over the globe to study on our campus, where our spirited community of learners is launching the next generation of big thinkers who will change the world.

Academic Programs
The University of West Florida is a vibrant institution with more than 70 undergraduate programs. Dedicated to helping a student population of more than 14,000 realize their full potential, UWF favors small class sizes with quality teacher-scholars who deliver personalized, hands-on learning and leadership opportunities. The University offers a dynamic learning environment that inspires innovation, creativity and collaboration and is focused on student success.
